title: China’s Nvidia Honeypot Isn’t Surprising. Jensen Huang Fell for It Anyway
gist: Garrett M. Graff argues that the alleged Chinese honeypot operation around Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, via Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, is a textbook counterintelligence play he should have anticipated, and that regardless of the truth Nvidia loses: the stock has fallen about a quarter in a month, shareholder suits loom, and the Trump administration faces congressional scrutiny over what it knew about a key Nvidia customer suspected of chip diversion.

insights.claim: US intelligence agencies warned top officials that Alice Huang, a former executive at Singapore-based cloud provider Megaspeed who allegedly had an affair with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang starting between 2024 and 2025, was a Chinese intelligence asset reporting to China's Ministry of State Security.
insights.speaker: Garrett M. Graff
insights.so_what: Key-person and national-security risk now attached to the world's most important AI chip supplier.

insights.so_what: Board probe outcome is a near-term catalyst for NVDA governance risk.
